note: _quia solus pius es_ (Clementina). How to render _pius_? Translators often opt for the meaning of “holy” (the Greek has ὅσιος): thou alone art holy (Douay Version); du allein bist heilig (Allioli); accordingly, the Nova Vulgata has _quia solus Sancus_. But the Latin, as it stands, may mean: car vous seul êtes miséricordieux (Glaire).
